info.title: Patchwork authenticated streams
info.description: Authenticated stream core with SSHSIG login, Biscuit attenuation, revisioned administration, pipelines, durable idempotency, bounded retention and SSE. Data routes require --data-api and local bootstrap. The server binds loopback; HTTPS clients can use a TLS frontend. Objects and snapshots are not implemented. KV, attachment and webhook routes are implemented but not yet described in this contract. Compatibility aliases without /v1 remain available.
